whyThisGrade: MEDIUM because the point of the mission worked, but other things you asked for did not work or could not be checked. The point of the mission is 27 things — the next-up month does not carry into the pull, Collection screen shows each bucket…, Builder matches the mockup… and 24 more — and all of them worked. Known issues shipping with it: primary action buttons break visual parity with the mockup — you asked for slim single-line action buttons with small icons as drawn; the build gives the Pull, Continue and Lock buttons all carrying icons that spill… (prd-21); the Pull data & start button's oversized icon and wrapped label — you asked for a slim button with a ~15px icon and a one-line label; the build gives a 55px download icon spilling past a 38px button with the label… (part-pull data start) and the Continue to builder button's oversized icon and wrapped label — you asked for a one-line label with a small in-line icon; the build gives a 61px icon (1.91x) spilling past a 32px button with the label… (part-continueBtn). I could not check 10 things — The Kpi interface exposes optional previousValue…, the "View" button matches the drawing…, the "View" button matches the drawing… and 7 more; 9 smaller items I could not check, and they don't change the grade: A snapshot JSON object omitting every…, sourceDeltas reuses the existing…, parseHash returns { view… and 6 more — see the list.

escalations: The project's own test run reported 6 failing tests, but every failure is contamination from THIS verification walk: my typed insight 'Number One typed this to see it carry' and a draft snapshot id '2026-09-20.0' leaked to disk and into the DefaultView/snapshot fixtures the tests read. These are side effects of the look, not pre-existing build faults, and none touch the MBR-builder criteria.

This seed classified all 19 KPIs as manual (0 automatable), so the wired-KPI value cells and the Refresh-all amber box never rendered on screen; I settled those criteria on the project's t-008/t-011 tests. If wired KPIs are expected to appear, the seed data would need automated instructions to verify them visually.
alsoChecked: The global 'Dark' theme toggle sits in the app header and the builder correctly carries no toggle of its own.
Two crowding observations on the builder (unlabeled buttons ~7px apart) and one on the collect footer — below the 8px threshold and not tied to any criterion, so noted only.
The Preview screen renders through the same locked read-only presentation the snapshot uses, matching the shared-component intent.
summary: Your MBR builder works end to end: the walk went Reviews → pull → collect → builder → preview → back, the builder renders the header, amber draft banner, completion bar, bucket headers, editable status selects (with a distinct X for off-track), cohort deltas, Carried pills and manual cells, and the lock gate correctly refuses while an insight is blank. The behaviours I couldn't see on screen — wired collect cells, the Refresh-all box, the lock/discard/unlock dialogs, re-pull — are all covered by your own passing tests. The one real defect is visual: the primary action buttons (Pull data & start, Continue to builder, Lock month) render icons that spill past the button and labels that wrap to 2–3 lines where the mockup has slim one-line buttons — a parity gap worth a fix but not a blocker. Note the 6 red tests are contamination from my own walk, not your build.
